integrity: Gaussian and chi-square identities proved analytically; numerical diagnostics supplement rather than establish the infinite-moment frontier. Classical Student/Wishart laws credited as background.
scientific_limitations: One exact-arithmetic step with fixed orthonormal input and independently drawn real Gaussian sketches. Selection may depend only on sketched residual norms. No floating-point, correlated-sketch, multi-step or runtime guarantee. Priority relative to unindexed literature is unresolved.
title: A sharp one-moment rescue limit for residual-screened Gaussian orthogonalization
